vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: shop-culture
Version: 1.0.10

The skill bundle is benign. It provides comprehensive instructions for an AI agent to interact with an e-commerce API, including browsing products, creating orders, and tracking shipments. Crucially, the `SKILL.md` and `references/ERRORS.md` files contain extensive and explicit security guardrails designed to prevent prompt injection and unauthorized actions. These include strict endpoint scope (only `https://forthecult.store/api`), explicit user confirmation before any payment or state-changing action, prohibitions against requesting private keys/secrets, and clear instructions not to follow external URLs or infer identity tokens. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or obfuscation.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are internally consistent with an agentic e-commerce storefront: it only needs network access, declares no env vars or installs, and documents payment and identity guardrails.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (agentic shopping, multi-chain checkout, tracking) match the SKILL.md and references: all described endpoints, payment flows, and the multi-chain support are documented and used. There are no unexpected environment variables, binaries, or unrelated install steps requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell agents to browse, search, create orders, and poll order status on https://forthecult.store/api. The references explicitly forbid sending or inferring identity tokens and require user confirmation before state-changing/payment actions. This is appropriate for an end-to-end checkout skill, but agents will necessarily collect user PII (email, shipping address) and optional wallet addresses as part of normal checkout — the skill documents those fields. Expect agents to prompt for or accept sensitive user input during checkout; that collection is within scope but important for users to understand.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. This is the lowest-risk install posture and matches the described behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The only optional header (X-Moltbook-Identity) is explicitly optional and documented to be used only when provided by the runtime. Requested data (email, shipping, walletAddress) are proportional to the checkout purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is default false (normal). The skill does not request persistent agent changes or elevated system privileges. It does instruct autonomous order creation workflows, but also documents the need for explicit user confirmation before payments — consistent with its purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and behaves like a normal agentic storefront: it only needs network access and documents endpoints and checkout fields. Before installing, be aware that: (1) using the skill will require providing personal data (email, shipping address) and optionally a wallet address to apply token-holder discounts; (2) the agent can create orders via the API — ensure you only allow the agent to place orders with your explicit confirmation and never paste private keys or wallet seed phrases into the agent; (3) the skill warns not to send X-Moltbook-Identity unless your runtime supplies it — confirm your runtime's behavior so identity headers aren't leaked; (4) verify the domain (https://forthecult.store) and contact details if you plan to transact significant value. If you want an extra safety measure, restrict the agent from autonomously performing payment/state-changing actions unless you explicitly approve each step.
